note: Archetypes are judgement written down in advance: three roles each invented profile could plausibly land. The programmes attached to them are real and were checked on 2026-09-22; each carries its url_status. Where an entry is one chamber’s offer, one Land’s procedure or a statute rather than a course, it says so in its own words: there is never one path per profession. Outreach targets are roles and organisation types, never people.

archetypes.label: Ward nurse, acute or geriatric care
archetypes.reason: Twelve years on general wards maps onto the German reference occupation once recognition is through.

requirements.german_why: Ward handovers and documentation are in German, and most Länder ask for B2 in the recognition procedure for nursing.

recognition.item: Recognition as Pflegefachfrau / Pflegefachmann has not been applied for
recognition.why: Nursing is regulated: the professional title cannot be used on a ward without recognition by the competent body of the Land.
recognition.typical_duration: typically 3-4 months for the authority's assessment once the file is complete, longer where documents must be sourced
recognition.next_step: Book free counselling and file the Antrag auf Anerkennung with the competent body of the Land (anerkennung-in-deutschland.de).

credentials.provider: Bundesinstitut für Berufsbildung (BIBB) / Anerkennung in Deutschland
credentials.why: The federal portal's step-by-step tool that identifies which authority handles a given profession in a given Bundesland and what the recognition application requires.
credentials.who_it_is_for: The portal addresses people with a vocational qualification obtained abroad who want to know whether and where a recognition procedure applies to them.
credentials.caveat: There is no national programme here: the authority and the shape of the compensation measure are set per Bundesland. This tool tells you which applies to you.
credentials.next_step: Start with free counselling: the authority, and what it will ask for, depends on your Bundesland.

credentials.provider: Anerkennung in Deutschland (BIBB) / IQ Netzwerk counselling centres
credentials.why: A directory of free counselling offices, largely run through the IQ Netzwerk, that advise on recognition procedures and on what documents an application needs.
credentials.who_it_is_for: The portal presents it for people who want advice on recognising a qualification obtained abroad before or during an application.
credentials.next_step: Start with free counselling: the authority, and what it will ask for, depends on your Bundesland.

credentials.item: Financial support for recognition, incl. the Anerkennungszuschuss
credentials.provider: Bundesministerium für Bildung und Forschung (BMBF) via Anerkennung in Deutschland
credentials.why: The federal overview page of grants that reimburse recognition-procedure costs such as translations, certifications and travel, with the Anerkennungszuschuss as the main federal scheme.
credentials.who_it_is_for: In the programme's own framing: people with a qualification obtained abroad, resident in Germany, whose income falls under stated limits; the page states that funding must be applied for before the recognition application is submitted.
credentials.next_step: Ask the listed body whether your case qualifies; eligibility is decided case by case.

language_programme.why: A German language certificate examination whose reading, listening, writing and speaking tasks are built around nursing work situations, reported at either B1 or B2.
language_programme.who_it_is_for: telc describes it as the German examination for nursing professionals who need to show German language competence for their profession.
language_programme.typical_duration: typically about 115 minutes written plus an oral part of about 16 minutes, per telc's stated exam structure
language_programme.next_step: Check the level the employer asks for before booking, and whether a funded course covers it.

outreach.target: Professional association for nursing (Berufsverband)
outreach.organisation: A nursing professional association active in the Land
outreach.why: Associations run peer groups for internationally qualified nurses and publish what the Land asks for.

outreach.target: Pflegekammer of the Land, where the Land has one
outreach.organisation: Land nursing chamber (not every Land has established one)
outreach.why: Where a nursing chamber exists it registers the profession and can say what registration needs.

outreach.target: Mentoring programme for internationally qualified health staff
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the health sector
outreach.why: Peer networks are where the practical sequence of the recognition steps gets explained by people who did it.

archetypes.label: Assistant post held during the recognition procedure
archetypes.reason: Assistant and Anerkennungspraktikum posts are the usual way to work on a ward while the file is with the authority.

requirements.german_why: Assistant posts still involve patient contact and shift handovers, and most ads in this group name B1.

recognition.item: The recognition application has not been filed, and this route depends on it being under way
recognition.why: An Anerkennungspraktikum is part of the procedure: employers in this group ask to see that the Antrag has been submitted.
recognition.typical_duration: typically a few weeks to prepare and file, once translated documents are in hand
recognition.next_step: File the Antrag first, then apply to posts in this group with the receipt.

credentials.item: Types of recognition procedure (Anpassungslehrgang and Kenntnisprüfung)
credentials.why: An explanation of the procedure routes, including the compensation measures — an adaptation course or a knowledge examination — that are set when substantial differences are found.
credentials.who_it_is_for: Written for applicants and advisers who need to understand which procedure type applies to a regulated profession.
credentials.caveat: Which route applies — adaptation course or knowledge examination — is set by the authority in your Bundesland, not here.
credentials.next_step: Start with free counselling: the authority, and what it will ask for, depends on your Bundesland.

credentials.why: Guidance on what the recognition decision means in practice, including what a partial-recognition notice obliges the holder to do next.
credentials.who_it_is_for: Aimed at applicants who have received a decision and need to work out the next step.
credentials.next_step: Start with free counselling: the authority, and what it will ask for, depends on your Bundesland.

credentials.why: A voucher through which the employment agency or jobcentre takes on the cost of an approved continuing-training measure, which can include adaptation courses.
credentials.who_it_is_for: In the agency's own framing: people whose training is needed to end unemployment or avert impending unemployment; the page states that a personal advisory meeting decides the individual case and that the provider and the course must be approved by a competent body.
credentials.next_step: Ask the listed body whether your case qualifies; eligibility is decided case by case.

language_programme.item: Berufssprachkurse zur Anerkennung beruflicher Abschlüsse im Gesundheitswesen
language_programme.why: Federally funded vocational German courses that teach the profession-specific language used in wards, care homes and outpatient care alongside the recognition procedure.
language_programme.who_it_is_for: BAMF names two target groups: academic health professions at target level C1, and Gesundheitsfachberufe including nurses and midwives at target level B2.
language_programme.typical_duration: typically 600 teaching units, the figure BAMF states for both course strands
language_programme.next_step: Check the level the employer asks for before booking, and whether a funded course covers it.

outreach.target: Recognition counselling service (IQ Netzwerk counselling centre)
outreach.organisation: Free official counselling on recognition procedures
outreach.why: Counselling is free and can tell you which employers in the Land take people mid-procedure.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: Chambers hold the employer lists and run information evenings for newcomers to the labour market.

outreach.target: Peer group for nurses in the recognition procedure
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the health sector
outreach.why: The order of the steps is the thing people get wrong, and peers have just done it.

archetypes.label: Care coordination, quality and case management
archetypes.reason: Twelve years and six roles carry the process knowledge these posts ask for, and they are not regulated.

requirements.german_why: These posts are mostly written German: documentation, audits and correspondence with payers.

credentials.provider: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Care und Case Management (DGCC)
credentials.why: A certified case-management qualification delivered by institutes the DGCC recognises, covering case-management method, supervision and practice work.
credentials.who_it_is_for: The DGCC addresses practitioners in health and social services — nursing, social work, disability services, insurance and employment integration — seeking a formal case-management qualification.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 210 continuing-education hours across modules, the scope DGCC states
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.provider: Bundesministerium der Justiz / Bundesamt für Justiz (gesetze-im-internet.de)
credentials.why: The statutory text that requires a care service to be led by a responsible nursing professional holding a management qualification of at least 460 hours; it is the legal basis, not a course.
credentials.who_it_is_for: It applies to nursing services and to the person named as the responsible nursing professional.
credentials.typical_duration: the statute names a qualification measure of at least 460 hours
credentials.caveat: This is the statute itself, not a course. The 460-hour qualification it names is delivered by many providers, and the conditions are set in Land law.
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.why: A federal scheme of grants and loans towards the cost of vocational advancement qualifications (Fortbildungsabschlüsse) and, in some cases, living costs during them.
credentials.who_it_is_for: In the scheme's own framing: people pursuing a vocational advancement qualification; the site's 'Wer wird gefördert?' section sets out the conditions.
credentials.next_step: Ask the listed body whether your case qualifies; eligibility is decided case by case.

language_programme.why: A workplace German examination reported at either B2 or C1, testing communication in written and spoken work situations.
language_programme.who_it_is_for: telc frames it for people who need to show work-related German across two levels in one examination.
language_programme.next_step: Check the level the employer asks for before booking, and whether a funded course covers it.

outreach.target: Professional association for health-service management
outreach.organisation: A management association in the health sector
outreach.why: Coordination posts are filled through sector networks more often than through portals.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: The chamber certifies several of the QM courses this route asks for.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified professionals in the health sector
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the health sector
outreach.why: Useful for finding employers that already hire outside the regulated route.

archetypes.label: Design engineer, CAD and product development
archetypes.reason: Eight years of machine building maps most directly onto Konstruktion posts.

requirements.german_why: Drawings, standards and supplier correspondence in this group are in German.

recognition.item: Permission to use the protected title Ingenieur has not been applied for
recognition.why: Working as an engineer is generally not restricted in Germany; only the title Ingenieur is. There is no single national procedure: sixteen Land engineering acts govern it, and the competent body is a Land chamber or a district government, sometimes both. For most employers the practical gap is a ZAB comparability statement and an anabin entry rather than a recognition decision.
recognition.typical_duration: varies by Land; one chamber currently states around three months
recognition.next_step: Check whether the posts you want actually carry the title. If they do, ask the Ingenieurkammer of your own Bundesland, not the one cited as an example below.

credentials.item: Statement of Comparability for foreign higher education qualifications
credentials.why: An official certificate that describes a foreign university degree and states which German qualification it compares to.
credentials.who_it_is_for: ZAB presents it as proof of a qualification towards German authorities, embassies and employers, including for visa and EU Blue Card applications; ZAB states it does not entitle the holder to work in a regulated profession and does not convert grades.
credentials.next_step: Start with free counselling: the authority, and what it will ask for, depends on your Bundesland.

credentials.item: Berufsbezeichnung Ingenieur with a degree obtained abroad
credentials.provider: Ingenieurkammer Niedersachsen (example of a Land chamber)
credentials.why: The chamber procedure that checks whether a degree obtained abroad is equivalent for the purpose of using the protected title Ingenieurin/Ingenieur; the chamber notes compensation measures where substantial differences are found.
credentials.who_it_is_for: The chamber addresses holders of engineering degrees obtained abroad who want to use the professional title; the title is governed by sixteen separate Land engineering acts, so the competent body differs by Bundesland.
credentials.typical_duration: typically around three months, the processing time this chamber currently states
credentials.caveat: One Land chamber, cited as an example. The title is governed by sixteen separate Land engineering acts, and the competent body where you live may be a different chamber or a district government.
credentials.next_step: Start with free counselling: the authority, and what it will ask for, depends on your Bundesland.

credentials.why: The engineering association's seminar and certificate-course programme for design and development work, covering current standards such as ISO GPS, dimensional and geometrical tolerancing, and development methods.
credentials.who_it_is_for: VDI addresses engineers and technical designers working in development and design who want training on these standards and methods.
credentials.caveat: A seminar programme rather than a single qualification; the individual seminars come and go.
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

language_programme.why: A workplace German examination reported at either B2 or C1, testing communication in written and spoken work situations.
language_programme.who_it_is_for: telc frames it for people who need to show work-related German across two levels in one examination.
language_programme.next_step: Check the level the employer asks for before booking, and whether a funded course covers it.

outreach.target: Engineering professional association
outreach.organisation: A national engineering association with Land branches
outreach.why: Branch evenings are where design departments say what they are hiring for.

outreach.target: Ingenieurkammer of the Land
outreach.organisation: Land chamber of engineers
outreach.why: It decides on the protected title and can say whether a post needs it.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified engineers
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for engineering
outreach.why: Title questions come up constantly there and the answers are Land-specific.

archetypes.label: Manufacturing and process planning
archetypes.reason: Series production experience fits Arbeitsvorbereitung and process posts, which do not need the protected title.

requirements.german_why: Shop-floor coordination and work instructions are in German.

credentials.why: A modular work-organisation qualification covering process analysis, time studies, work design and planning, closing with REFA examinations and a REFA certificate.
credentials.who_it_is_for: REFA names specialists and managers, industrial and craft masters, technicians and staff from assembly and production planning.
credentials.duration_note: REFA lists the full Grundausbildung across four parts; the 4.0 variants split it differently, so treat any single figure with care.
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.item: DGQ Lean Six Sigma certification path (Yellow / Green / Black Belt)
credentials.why: The quality association's certification route for Six Sigma and Lean process-improvement roles, built on the DMAIC model with an examination and a practice project.
credentials.who_it_is_for: DGQ addresses staff and managers in production and service companies who run process-improvement projects in their own area.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 8 course days for the Green Belt, including the examination day, per DGQ's course description
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.item: anabin — database of foreign education institutions and degrees
credentials.why: The public ZAB database that records how foreign higher-education institutions and degrees are classified in Germany, which employers and authorities consult directly.
credentials.who_it_is_for: Open to anyone needing to look up how an institution or degree is classified; it is a database entry, not a certificate.
credentials.next_step: Start with free counselling: the authority, and what it will ask for, depends on your Bundesland.

credentials.why: A federal scheme of grants and loans towards the cost of vocational advancement qualifications (Fortbildungsabschlüsse) and, in some cases, living costs during them.
credentials.who_it_is_for: In the scheme's own framing: people pursuing a vocational advancement qualification; the site's 'Wer wird gefördert?' section sets out the conditions.
credentials.next_step: Ask the listed body whether your case qualifies; eligibility is decided case by case.

outreach.target: Association for work organisation and industrial engineering
outreach.organisation: A methods and work-organisation association
outreach.why: It runs the qualification this route asks for and knows which plants accept it.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: Chambers keep the local manufacturer lists and certify further training.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified engineers
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for engineering
outreach.why: Good for finding plants that hire without the protected title.

archetypes.label: Technical service and commissioning
archetypes.reason: Field service and commissioning accept a lower German level and value the breadth of eight years.

requirements.german_why: Customer visits need spoken German, but reports in this group are often short and templated.

credentials.item: Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten (IHK) nach DGUV Vorschrift 3
credentials.provider: IHK Würzburg-Schweinfurt (one of many IHKs offering this course)
credentials.why: A certificate course under DGUV Vorschrift 3 and DGUV-Grundsatz 303-001 that authorises named electrical tasks on installations and machines for people who did not train as electricians.
credentials.who_it_is_for: The IHK names skilled workers from all commercial-technical non-electrical trades.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 120 teaching units in this IHK's listing; DGUV sets a minimum of 80 teaching units, and other IHKs schedule differently
credentials.caveat: One chamber’s course, cited as an example. Every IHK runs its own version with its own dates, scope and admission handling.
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.item: Statement of Comparability for foreign higher education qualifications
credentials.why: An official certificate that describes a foreign university degree and states which German qualification it compares to.
credentials.who_it_is_for: ZAB presents it as proof of a qualification towards German authorities, embassies and employers, including for visa and EU Blue Card applications; ZAB states it does not entitle the holder to work in a regulated profession.
credentials.next_step: Start with free counselling: the authority, and what it will ask for, depends on your Bundesland.

credentials.why: The employment agency's route by which an employer applies for subsidies towards course costs and, in some cases, wages while an employee trains.
credentials.who_it_is_for: In the agency's own framing: companies wanting to qualify their existing staff; the application runs through the employer, and the local agency assesses each case.
credentials.next_step: Ask the listed body whether your case qualifies; eligibility is decided case by case.

credentials.item: German driving licence, or conversion (Umschreibung) of a non-EU licence
credentials.provider: Fahrerlaubnisbehörde of the city you live in
credentials.why: Field-service adverts in this group ask for Fuhrerschein Klasse B as a condition of the post.
credentials.who_it_is_for: Anyone holding a licence issued outside the EU or EEA who intends to keep driving after the first six months.
credentials.typical_duration: typically 2-6 months, depending on whether a test is required
credentials.caveat: No programme link: conversion is handled by the licensing office of your city, and the rules depend on the issuing country.
credentials.next_step: Ask the Fahrerlaubnisbehörde of your city which rules apply to your licence.

language_programme.why: The federal system of vocational German courses, with basic courses at target levels B2 and C1 and special courses for particular occupational fields, ending in a Deutsch-Test für den Beruf.
language_programme.who_it_is_for: BAMF frames them for immigrants who need work-related German; courses run full time or part time, at a provider or with an employer.
language_programme.next_step: Check the level the employer asks for before booking, and whether a funded course covers it.

outreach.target: Engineering professional association, service and maintenance branch
outreach.organisation: A national engineering association with Land branches
outreach.why: Service departments recruit through the branch groups.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: It certifies the short electrical qualification this route may need.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified technical staff
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for engineering
outreach.why: Licence conversion is a recurring topic there.

archetypes.label: Backend developer in an English-working team
archetypes.reason: Five years of backend work fits the teams that run in English and do not ask for recognition.

requirements.german_why: The English-only posts do not need it, but the rest of this group asks for at least B1 for everything outside the codebase.

credentials.why: A vendor examination on developing, deploying and debugging applications on AWS.
credentials.who_it_is_for: AWS frames it for people with development experience on its platform; there is no German public body that certifies backend developers, so vendor certificates are what job ads name.
credentials.caveat: A private vendor certificate, not a German qualification. It is listed only because no public body certifies this role.
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.why: The public search over continuing-training courses in Germany, marking which courses and providers are approved for public funding.
credentials.who_it_is_for: Open to anyone; it shows which courses a Bildungsgutschein or other public funding could be used for, without deciding any individual case.
credentials.next_step: Ask the listed body whether your case qualifies; eligibility is decided case by case.

language_programme.why: The federal system of vocational German courses, with basic courses at target levels B2 and C1, available full time or part time including evening classes.
language_programme.who_it_is_for: BAMF frames them for immigrants who need work-related German; courses can be run at a provider or directly with an employer.
language_programme.next_step: Check the level the employer asks for before booking, and whether a funded course covers it.

outreach.target: Professional association for computing
outreach.organisation: A national computing society with local chapters
outreach.why: Chapters run the meetups where English-working teams recruit.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: It keeps the local employer register and runs newcomer information evenings.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified tech professionals
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the tech sector
outreach.why: Referrals here reach the teams that already hire without German.

archetypes.label: Data engineer, pipelines and warehousing
archetypes.reason: The data half of the profile fits pipeline and warehouse posts, which are the most English-tolerant group here.

requirements.german_why: Stakeholders outside the data team are usually German-speaking, even where the team is not.

credentials.why: A vendor examination on building and operating data pipelines, storage and transformation on AWS.
credentials.who_it_is_for: AWS frames it for people with data-engineering experience on its platform; no German public body certifies data engineers, so vendor certificates are what job ads name.
credentials.caveat: A private vendor certificate, not a German qualification. It is listed only because no public body certifies this role.
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.why: A voucher through which the employment agency or jobcentre takes on the cost of an approved continuing-training measure.
credentials.who_it_is_for: In the agency's own framing: people whose training is needed to end unemployment or avert impending unemployment; a personal advisory meeting decides the individual case, and both provider and course must be approved by a competent body.
credentials.next_step: Ask the listed body whether your case qualifies; eligibility is decided case by case.

language_programme.why: A workplace German examination reported at either B2 or C1, testing communication in written and spoken work situations.
language_programme.who_it_is_for: telc frames it for people who need to show work-related German across two levels in one examination.
language_programme.next_step: Check the level the employer asks for before booking, and whether a funded course covers it.

outreach.target: Professional association for computing, data chapter
outreach.organisation: A national computing society with local chapters
outreach.why: Data chapters are small and the hiring leads speak at them.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: Industrial employers hiring data staff are on the chamber's register rather than on job portals.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified tech professionals
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the tech sector
outreach.why: The same referral route as the backend archetype, different rooms.

archetypes.label: IT operations and platform administration
archetypes.reason: Operations posts are the widest door for a developer without German, though the German-facing ones ask for more language.

requirements.german_why: Operations touches every other department, and support conversations in this group are in German.

credentials.why: A vendor-neutral certification, taken as two examinations, on installing, configuring and maintaining Linux systems and command-line administration.
credentials.who_it_is_for: LPI frames it as its entry-level professional certification for Linux system administration.
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.item: Externenprüfung — IHK final examination without an apprenticeship
credentials.provider: IHK Berlin (one of many IHKs; rules and contact differ by chamber district)
credentials.why: Admission to the IHK final examination in a recognised training occupation such as Fachinformatiker on the basis of work experience rather than a completed apprenticeship, under §§ 46 and 62 BBiG.
credentials.who_it_is_for: In the IHK's words: experienced practitioners whose work has covered the essential requirements of the target occupation, normally evidenced by one and a half times the usual training duration; applicants apply to the IHK for the district where they live.
credentials.typical_duration: the IHK states a practical-experience requirement of about 4.5 years for a three-year occupation
credentials.caveat: One chamber’s rules, cited as an example. Admission is handled per chamber district and differs between them.
credentials.next_step: Check with the provider which variant applies to you before booking anything.

credentials.why: A voucher through which the employment agency or jobcentre takes on the cost of an approved continuing-training measure, including retraining and partial qualifications.
credentials.who_it_is_for: In the agency's own framing: people whose training is needed to end unemployment or avert impending unemployment; a personal advisory meeting decides the individual case, and both provider and course must be approved by a competent body.
credentials.next_step: Ask the listed body whether your case qualifies; eligibility is decided case by case.

language_programme.why: The federal system of vocational German courses, with basic courses at target levels B2 and C1 and special courses for particular occupational fields.
language_programme.who_it_is_for: BAMF frames them for immigrants who need work-related German; courses run full time or part time, at a provider or with an employer.
language_programme.next_step: Check the level the employer asks for before booking, and whether a funded course covers it.

outreach.target: Professional association for computing, systems chapter
outreach.organisation: A national computing society with local chapters
outreach.why: Operations roles are filled by word of mouth more than the developer ones.

outreach.target: Industrie- und Handelskammer of the city
outreach.organisation: Chamber of commerce and industry, present in every German city
outreach.why: Mid-sized employers with in-house IT are on the chamber register.

outreach.target: Network for internationally qualified tech professionals
outreach.organisation: A migrant-professional network for the tech sector
outreach.why: Where the German-language expectation gets discussed honestly.

programmes_source.note: Merged from a link-checked programme survey. Fee information was deliberately not recorded, and nothing here states that any particular person qualifies for anything.
